messages.content: Decide only whether two adjacent source responsibilities belong to one local beat job. Return JSON only.

LEFT:
The technician completes one sample test and places the sample aside.

RIGHT:
The technician immediately begins a fresh test on the next sample.

Choose one:
MERGE = RIGHT is an immediate reaction to LEFT, continues the same uninterrupted local action, or is the immediate mechanical completion of what LEFT just obtained/opened/started.
NEW_TASK = LEFT reaches a usable stopping point and RIGHT begins a distinct local action/objective. Starting a fresh item/test after LEFT completed one is NEW_TASK. Merely carrying or wearing something from LEFT while doing a different task is NEW_TASK.
Judge only the concrete local actions.
Return exactly {"relation":"MERGE|NEW_TASK"}.

message.reasoning:
We need to decide if RIGHT is MERGE or NEW_TASK relative to LEFT.

LEFT: "The technician completes one sample test and places the sample aside."

So action: complete a test, then place sample aside. That ends that local task? The sample test is completed; placing it aside is part of finishing that test. So after this, the next step is starting fresh test on next sample.

RIGHT: "The technician immediately begins a fresh test on the next sample."

Is this an immediate reaction to LEFT, continues same uninterrupted local action, or mechanical completion of what LEFT just obtained/opened/started? The test was completed; placing aside. Starting new test is distinct objective. So it's NEW_TASK. Because starting a fresh item/test after completing one is NEW_TASK.

Thus relation: "NEW_TASK". Return JSON exactly {"relation":"NEW_TASK"}
